title: Doctrine
description: A faction's skirmish doctrine (network design §2.3 and §6.1; N3 prep LD2, ruled 16 Oct): what a seat may build and the logistics it starts a match with. N3's minimum only -- WP-G-G extends it with the commander. Read by nothing in the runtime yet; `pnpm validate:data` (tools/validate_doctrine.mjs) holds the cross-file rules the schema cannot see: every menu id is a unit of the doctrine's own side, no menu holds `loiter_drone` (LD3), and the Sarim budget is 1.6x the KDF's (G3 Q7).

faction.description: The seat faction a room's matchup picks (`@lions/net` `Faction`). A `sarim` doctrine's menu may hold any opposition unit (sarim, rif or ashwar faction), as `VERSUS_SARIM` already fields the Rif `gun_truck`.

name.description: Display name, plain English, as a unit's `name` is.

menu.description: Unit ids the seat may build at its camp, in dock order. Each must be a unit in data/units of the doctrine's own side.

logistics_start.description: The seat's purse at tick 0, in whole logistics -- the unit of a unit's `cost.logistics` and of `resources.logistics_start`; the sim scales it by PURSE_UNITS (F2). This is what F4's per-side `MissionContext.economy.start` reads. There is no base rate here: a skirmish is paid by held zones only (G3 Q2), so the versus rules file sets each side's rate to 0. The Sarim/KDF ratio of these numbers is pinned at 1.6 (G3 Q7).

status.description: `provisional` until G4's re-sweep of G3 Q7 (1.45-1.8x over 30 seeds) sets the numbers; `swept` after it. No balance claim is made while it reads provisional.
